# Manual silk evidence

These three boards contain the label `B7` on the front silkscreen layer.
The stroke thicknesses are 2.9, 3.0 and 3.1 mil.
The test worker measures the saved stroke thickness with pcbnew.
The independent expectation compares that thickness with the profile value of 3 mil.

The test supplies the result through the bound manual-evidence route.
The product does not automatically inspect the rendered silkscreen.
The supplier setup guide states a separate 5 mil minimum.
These fixtures do not establish physical manufacturing results.
